translations.web: They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless him all day long.
translations.bsb: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.
translations.kjv: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
translations.asv: And they shall live; and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: And men shall pray for him continually; They shall bless him all the day long.
